about.title: About
body: Hi, I'm Daniel, a PHP developer from Poland.
For three years at ModulesGarden I built WHMCS modules used by hosting companies. Now I build Laravel apps and admin panels for clients, plus OnSide, my own platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.
I like simple, reliable code and admin panels that are fast to work with.
